title: Topological Self-Assembly of Highly Symmetric Lanthanide Clusters: A Magnetic Study of Exchange-Coupling “Fingerprints” in Giant Gadolinium(III) Cages

synthesis.procedure: A mixture of Gd(NO3)3·6H2O, N-methyldiethanolamine, triethylamine and methanol was heated in a glass vial at 130 °C for 12 h. After natural cooling, the product was filtered and washed with methanol to give colorless plate crystals.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Cooled naturally to room temperature, filtered and washed with a little methanol; colorless plate crystals.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The nine Gd(III) sites form two vertex-sharing square-based pyramids. Hydroxides bridge triangular faces and the distorted square bases.

material_class.structural_family: Chloride-templated cage of Gd4 tetrahedral units

synthesis.procedure: Solid 2,2-dimethylolpropionic acid and NaCl were added to aqueous Gd(ClO4)3. The mixture was stirred near 90 °C while 2 M aqueous NaOH was added dropwise until a persistent incipient precipitate formed. The mixture was filtered and the pH 5–6 filtrate concentrated until a crystalline film appeared. Crystals were isolated and recrystallized from ethanol for diffraction.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Stirred aqueous reaction followed by concentration and ethanol recrystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered; concentrated the filtrate until a crystalline film formed; collected colorless crystals, washed with ice-cold water and recrystallized from ethanol.
synthesis.yield: Approximately 0.4 g; 69% based on the ligand

synthesis.procedure: Gd(NO3)3·6H2O and 6-chloro-2-pyridinol were stirred in methanol and acetonitrile, then triethylamine was added. After 12 h the solution was filtered and allowed to evaporate near 20 °C. Colorless plate crystals formed after five days.

synthesis.vessel_or_method: Stirred solution followed by solvent evaporation in a beaker
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered after stirring and left to evaporate at room temperature; colorless plate-shaped crystals.

synthesis.procedure: Method A: Gd(NO3)3·6H2O, N-methyldiethanolamine and triethylamine were heated in methanol in a glass vial at 130 °C for three days. After natural cooling, the product was filtered and washed with methanol to obtain colorless block crystals. A second reported route heated isolated Gd9 with triethylamine in methanol under the same conditions.

synthesis.procedure: Isolated Gd15 was dissolved in ethanol, sealed in a 15 mL Teflon-lined autoclave and heated at 150 °C for 24 h. The autoclave was cooled to room temperature at 5 °C h−1; flaky crystals were filtered, washed with ethanol and dried under vacuum.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 15 mL Teflon-lined autoclave; solvothermal conversion of Gd15
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Slowly cooled, filtered, washed with ethanol and dried under vacuum; flaky crystals.

synthesis.procedure: Gd(NO3)3·6H2O, 2,2-dimethylolpropionic acid and trimethylamine were dissolved in methanol, acetonitrile and water. The slurry was sealed in a 15 mL vial, heated at 130 °C for 12 h and cooled to room temperature over 30 h. The resulting octahedron-like crystals were filtered and washed with methanol.
